title: Student empowerment
summary: Our heartfelt thanks to Rtn Hemen Ruparel, who has graciously donated Rs 45000/- to support one BSC IT student through VSM project for 2026-27.
description: Our heartfelt thanks to Rtn Hemen Ruparel, who has graciously donated Rs 45000/- to support one BSC IT student through VSM project for 2026-27. Supporting a student with professional education is equivalent to supporting their family for generations to come in that family. Our sincere thanks, appreciation and gratitude to Hemen Ruparel for his generosity and kindness in sponsoring the student and also strengthening our club’s contribution towards community service.
location: Vidyadaan Sahayak Mandal, Thane, Mumbai, Maharashtra
